title: Professional Introduction
description: Introduce your experience clearly to an international colleague.
scenario: You are meeting a new international team for the first time.
initial_question: Tell me about yourself and your professional experience.
transfer_question: How would you introduce yourself to a new international team?
language_policy: Tutor speaks concise English and accepts English learner responses.
correction_policy: Select one primary and at most one distinct secondary correction.
completion_rules: First attempt, retry, transfer, evidence, summary and review.
prompt_context: Keep the introduction professional, brief and supportive.
